newsitem.title: UK: Next firms after pre-results press comment.
newsitem.headline: Next firms after pre-results press comment.

text.p: Shares in Next Plc climbed on Monday after positive newspaper comment on the clothing retail sector fuelled interest in the company ahead of its annual results, dealers said.
The shares climbed eight pence to 605 by 0920 GMT.
A report in the Financial Times newspaper said a new survey had shown that privately owned clothing retailers in the UK were achieving impressive returns on capital and sales growth.
Although the report said quoted companies were faring less well in general, dealers said it showed the market was healthy and that well-managed clothes retailers could prosper.
"There's been some good press comment about the sector and people will be looking to get into Next ahead of their results," one market maker said.
Next reports annual results on Wedesday, with analysts expecting pre-tax profits between 152 and 157 million stg.
